schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Swarojgar Yojana 2.0
schemes.benefit: Bank-linked support for setting up enterprises; earlier MSY and Nano merged for 2025-26 to 2029-30.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand self-employment applicants; detailed conditions require DIC confirmation.
schemes.access: Confirm the current MSY 2.0 application service and requirements with the District Industries Centre.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 — capital subsidy
schemes.benefit: Location and investment-slab based capital assistance on eligible assets.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; location category and policy exclusions apply.
schemes.access: Submit the single-window CAF and obtain in-principle approval before commercial production; file the incentive claim through the prescribed portal and DIC.
schemes.caution: CAF approval before production is mandatory. Manufacturing eligibility, district category, eligible assets and claim deadlines control sanction; expansion units receive only eligible capital subsidy.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 — DPR reimbursement
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 75% of empanelled-consultant DPR fees.
schemes.eligible: New micro manufacturing enterprises meeting the policy conditions.
schemes.access: Submit the single-window CAF and obtain in-principle approval before commercial production; file the incentive claim through the prescribed portal and DIC.
schemes.caution: CAF approval before production is mandatory. Manufacturing eligibility, district category, eligible assets and claim deadlines control sanction; expansion units receive only eligible capital subsidy.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 — stamp-duty reimbursement
schemes.benefit: Land stamp-duty reimbursement by area category: A/B 100%, C 75%, D 50%.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; location category and policy exclusions apply.
schemes.access: Submit the single-window CAF and obtain in-principle approval before commercial production; file the incentive claim through the prescribed portal and DIC.
schemes.caution: CAF approval before production is mandatory. Manufacturing eligibility, district category, eligible assets and claim deadlines control sanction; expansion units receive only eligible capital subsidy.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand Startup Policy 2023
schemes.benefit: Recognition-linked incubation, seed, intellectual-property and ecosystem support; financial terms need operative-policy verification.
schemes.eligible: Recognised innovative startups satisfying state-policy requirements.
schemes.access: Check recognition and live incentive services on Startup Uttarakhand through the MSME startup cell.

schemes.name: Tourism Policy 2023 investment incentives
schemes.benefit: Programme support for qualifying tourism projects; amounts and approval conditions require current guidelines.
schemes.eligible: Eligible tourism entrepreneurs under the respective programme.
schemes.access: Check the UTDB investment portal and district tourism office for the scheme application and current sanction process.

schemes.name: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Tourism Self-Employment Scheme
schemes.benefit: Programme support for qualifying tourism projects; amounts and approval conditions require current guidelines.
schemes.eligible: Eligible tourism entrepreneurs under the respective programme.
schemes.access: Check the UTDB investment portal and district tourism office for the scheme application and current sanction process.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand Paryatan Udhyami Protsahan Yojana
schemes.benefit: Programme support for qualifying tourism projects; amounts and approval conditions require current guidelines.
schemes.eligible: Eligible tourism entrepreneurs under the respective programme.
schemes.access: Check the UTDB investment portal and district tourism office for the scheme application and current sanction process.

schemes.name: Deendayal Upadhyay Grah Aawas Homestay Vikas Yojana
schemes.benefit: Homestay development route; registration is separate from subsidy sanction.
schemes.eligible: Permanent Uttarakhand residents with a rural homestay location under the current registration declaration.
schemes.access: Register through the UTDB homestay portal; confirm finance and subsidy application with the district tourism office.
schemes.caution: June 2026 registration declaration requires rural location and permanent residency. Historical policy descriptions mentioning urban homestays should not be relied on. Current subsidy slabs and budget remain unconfirmed.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Rajya Pashudhan Mission
schemes.benefit: Interest support for approved dairy, small-animal, draft-animal and poultry units; current sanction norms apply.
schemes.eligible: Uttarakhand residents establishing prescribed animal units.
schemes.access: Apply at the local veterinary hospital with lender consent for the proposed loan.

schemes.name: Goat Valley
schemes.benefit: Cluster goat-rearing units combining loan, subsidy and beneficiary contribution.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand residents selected for the notified goat cluster.
schemes.access: Apply through Apuni Sarkar; block-level scrutiny and cluster selection apply.

schemes.name: Poultry Valley
schemes.benefit: Poultry inputs and cooperative credit for approved low-input poultry units.
schemes.eligible: Eligible mPACS members with land and required non-default status; women receive preference.
schemes.access: Apply through mPACS and the veterinary/cooperative departments.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.benefit: Fish-production and self-employment components; current approved component norms control support.
schemes.eligible: Applicants meeting the selected fisheries component requirements.
schemes.access: Submit an application to the concerned district fisheries office.

schemes.name: Deendayal Upadhyay Sahkarita Kisan Kalyan Yojana
schemes.benefit: Indicative official summary: interest-free loans up to ₹3 lakh for individuals and ₹5 lakh for SHGs; sanction terms apply.
schemes.eligible: Eligible small/marginal cooperative members and approved groups.
schemes.access: Apply at the cooperative society or bank branch; block selection and PACS/DCB lending follow.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Ghasiyari Kalyan Yojana
schemes.benefit: Concessional silage and animal-feed distribution through cooperative channels.
schemes.eligible: Covered hill livestock keepers and participating cooperative feed producers.
schemes.access: Confirm local availability with the silage distribution centre or cooperative society.

schemes.name: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
schemes.benefit: Cooperative-bank finance for approved motorcycle taxi self-employment.
schemes.eligible: Eligible permanent Uttarakhand residents satisfying transport and bank conditions.
schemes.access: Submit the prescribed loan application to the district cooperative bank for district selection.

schemes.name: E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana
schemes.benefit: Finance route for approved e-rickshaw operations; current bank terms require confirmation.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand resident drivers meeting scheme and lending conditions.
schemes.access: Obtain a vehicle quotation and apply through the relevant cooperative bank.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana
schemes.benefit: State solar self-employment programme listed with a March 2023 update; current capacity, tariff and finance norms unverified.
schemes.eligible: Eligible state applicants meeting UREDA project and grid-connectivity conditions.
schemes.access: Confirm the current MSSY application and grid feasibility through UREDA and UPCL.

schemes.name: Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
schemes.benefit: Department-listed women dairy development route; live animal-unit terms and allocation require confirmation.
schemes.eligible: Eligible women dairy applicants under the department rules.
schemes.access: Confirm participation through the Dairy Development Department and local milk union.

schemes.name: Milk Incentive Yojana
schemes.benefit: Incentive route for qualifying cooperative milk supply; current rate and payment eligibility unconfirmed.
schemes.eligible: Eligible participating milk producers under the department rules.
schemes.access: Confirm eligible milk supply and claim process through the milk cooperative or district dairy office.
